accessibility:
- The root is a `<div class="file">` with a nested `<label>` and `<input type="file">`.
- The label is always clickable.
- When `File` renders its own `Field` (that is, outside an existing one), the Field-level `label` prop is automatically associated with the file input via `htmlFor`, so the input then has two labels (the Field label plus the wrapping CTA label); assistive technology reads both. An explicit `labelProps.htmlFor` overrides the association and no id is generated.
- Add `aria-label` to the `<input>` for accessibility if your label is not plain text.
summary: The `File` component provides a Bulma-styled file input, supporting color, size, boxed/fullwidth/align styles, icons, "has name", and filename display.

parts.summary: The `File` component provides a Bulma-styled file input, supporting color, size, boxed/fullwidth/align styles, icons, "has name", and filename display.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label. Automatically associated with the file input via `htmlFor` — uses your `id` when provided, otherwise a generated one. The input then has two labels (this one plus the wrapping `file-label`); assistive tech reads both. Dropped inside an outer `Field` (label that `Field` yourself).

props.name: labelProps
props.description: Props for the label element. An explicit `htmlFor` here overrides the automatic association (no id is generated then).

props.name: color
props.description: Bulma color modifier for the file input.

props.name: size
props.description: Size modifier for the file input.

props.name: isBoxed
props.description: Boxed file input.

props.name: isFullwidth
props.description: Whether the file input expands to full width.

props.name: isFullWidth
props.description: Whether the file input expands to full width.
props.deprecationNote: Use `isFullwidth` instead — `isFullwidth` wins if both are set.

props.name: isRight
props.description: Position the CTA on the right (with `hasName`).

props.name: isCentered
props.description: Center the file input within its container.

props.name: hasName
props.description: Show a file name indicator.

props.name: buttonLabel
props.description: Text on the file CTA button (defaults to "Choose a file…").

props.name: iconLeft
props.description: Left icon element.

props.name: iconRight
props.description: Right icon element.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply.

props.name: inputClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the `<input>`.

props.name: fileName
props.description: File name to display.

props.name: labelSize
props.description: Size for the label (used in horizontal layouts).

props.name: horizontal
props.description: Horizontal field layout.

props.name: message
props.description: Help/validation message below the input.

props.name: messageColor
props.description: Bulma color for the message.

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the Field wrapper.

props.name: ref
props.description: Forwarded to the underlying element.

parts.catchAll: All standard <input> attributes and Bulma helper props
